evals.prompt: I need to assemble a SOC 2 evidence bundle — give me SBOM, SARIF, VEX, all the artefacts.
evals.expected_output: A bundle directory under `.vulnetix/compliance/<ISO8601>/` containing CycloneDX SBOM, SPDX licenses, SARIF findings, CycloneDX VEX, manifest.json with SHA-256 sums, and a Markdown README.
expectations: `vulnetix triage --provider vulnetix --vex-format cyclonedx -o json > $OUT/vex.cdx.json` is invoked
`$OUT/manifest.json` is written with SHA-256 sums of every artifact

evals.prompt: Cut a signed compliance bundle for the v3.2 release please.
evals.expected_output: A signed bundle: SBOM/SARIF generated, plus cosign sign-blob bundles next to each artefact when cosign is available.
expectations: `cosign sign-blob --yes $OUT/sbom.cdx.json --bundle $OUT/sbom.cdx.json.sig.bundle` is invoked when cosign is present
`cosign sign-blob --yes $OUT/findings.sarif --bundle $OUT/findings.sarif.sig.bundle` is invoked when cosign is present
If cosign is absent, skill surfaces an install hint and continues unsigned
Final report line reads `Signed: yes` or `Signed: no` with cosign availability

evals.prompt: Customer security questionnaire wants SBOM plus signed attestations — produce the bundle.
evals.expected_output: A complete compliance bundle suitable for customer submission with component, license, finding, and VEX counts reported.
expectations: Report lists component count for the CycloneDX SBOM
Report lists license count and conflict count from the SPDX file
Report lists critical/high/medium counts from the SARIF
Skill suggests `/vulnetix:vex-publish --upload` as a next step
